notes.title: QoL update on display resolutions and UI
notes.notes:
[h3]Improved Display Handling:[/h3]
[list]
[*]On first launch, the game now automatically selects the nearest 16:9 aspect ratio resolution and sets fullscreen mode by default.
[*]If the selected resolution isn't native, letterboxing will be applied to maintain aspect ratio.
[*]Only 16:9 resolutions that are integer-scaled from 640x360 are supported for pixel-perfect
rendering.
[/list]
[h3]UI Enhancement:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Adjusted font size on the Game Over screen for better readability across different resolutions.
[/list]

notes.title: Resolution Compatibility and Ultrawide Monitor Support
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I've added a note in the Video Settings to clarify that this game is optimized for 16:9 resolutions with integer scaling (e.g., 1280x720, 1920x1080, 2560x1440 etc.) to maintain pixel-perfect rendering. Using other resolutions might cause visual artifacts or misalignment. This should help reduce confusion, especially for those with ultrawide monitors.

Thanks for your understanding and support!
